data.title: 三司绫濑 · 书店里的安静角落
data.description: 书店里没有人认出她。绫濑在书架旁翻开一本书，看到有趣的地方，忍不住多站了一会儿。
data.action: reading an open book beside a bookshelf
data.promptProse: Amidst the quiet, orderly aisles of a quaint bookshop, Ayase stands engrossed in an open book, her focus entirely captured by the pages. Soft, diffused ambient light filters down from shop lamps, reflecting subtly on the glossy book covers and highlighting the serene, scholarly atmosphere as she lingers peacefully by the towering wooden bookshelves.
